ModMetaData.name: SmartWallLights
ModMetaData.author: lpk23
ModMetaData.description:
SmartWallLights helps place wall lights around a room quickly.
Select a wall light, hold Shift, and hover over a room wall. The mod previews the planned layout and places the lights automatically after you click.
Includes efficient, symmetric, and hybrid placement modes. Requires Harmony.
